headline: Dominant interior scoring and exceptional mid-range accuracy defined Jokić's high-efficiency shooting season.
strengths: From less than 8 feet, Jokić made 68.3% of his 804 attempts, which was 9.3 points above the league average on the same range.
From 8 to 16 feet, he converted 57.0% of his 158 attempts, exceeding the league average on the same range by 14.0 points.
watch: From 24 or more feet, he converted 34.0% of his 285 attempts, finishing 1.5 points below the league average on the same range.
context: Shots from less than 10 feet comprised 64.5% of his total diet across 846 attempts. He took 55.8% of his field goals under tight coverage with a defender 2 to 4 feet away. Just over half of his total volume, 51.4%, occurred in the middle of the shot clock between 15 and 7 seconds.
